items.heading: Thieboudienne Mauritanien
details: Key ingredients: rice, fish, tomato, vegetables
Stuff whole fish with a herb paste and fry lightly.
Simmer the fish with tomato and mixed vegetables.
Cook rice in the flavorful broth left behind.
Serve the rice topped with the fish and vegetables.

items.heading: Mechoui
details: Key ingredients: whole lamb, salt, cumin
Season a whole lamb generously with salt and cumin.
Skewer and roast slowly over an open fire or in a pit.
Turn occasionally, basting with fat, until deeply tender.
Carve and serve with flatbread.
